items.title: Tauri app/bundle configuration (base + Windows + Linux overrides)
items.rationale: Carries the shared identity: identifier app.crynta.terax (tauri.conf.json:5, derives app data/config/local-data dirs and the WebView profile, hence localStorage), updater pubkey+endpoint (:118-123), createUpdaterArtifacts (:48), sidecar name binaries/terax-cli (:38-40). Phase 0 must change identifier and updater (F0:4, F0:10, identity:1, ADR-008, 13.2:21-22, 16:26). productName/title/descriptions/copyright/publisher/'Terax Document' are visual rebranding (identity:2). fileAssociations (:98-113) register lut as editor for ~60 code extensions, which contradicts 2.3 (not an editor); CSP connect-src https: (:29) exists for BYOK AI (ADR-004) and can be tightened once AI is removed.
couplings: ide-tools (fileAssociations open files in editor, preview frame-src)
items.risks: Changing productName changes the main binary/installer names and the NSIS install dir; the identifier change resets window-state, stores and localStorage (acceptable: no lut users yet).

items.title: Updater check/install hook (frontend)
items.rationale: User decision 5 (analysis/decisions.md): tauri-plugin-updater is removed in Phase 0; lut's own updater is re-added in F7. (Analyst: Calls plugin-updater check() (useUpdater.ts:104) on mount and on Linux fetches https://api.github.com/repos/crynta/terax-ai/releases/latest (:9-10, :52). F0:4 requires it never reaches Terax infrastructure; F7:auto-actualizacion-de-lut rebuilds it with lut endpoint, own key, channel and opt-out. Logic (status machine, throttle) is reusable; endpoints are not.)
items.risks: Removing the plugin without removing the import in AboutSection/App breaks the build; keep F0 change minimal (disable) and leave removal/rebuild to F7.

items.title: Updater dialog UI
items.rationale: User decision 5 (analysis/decisions.md): removed with the updater plugin; F7 re-adds an update UI per the user's design. (Analyst: Purely visual Terax component; lut's update UX is designed by the user (F7:auto-actualizacion-de-lut, F7:6). Until then it is inert once the check is disabled.)
items.risks: None while the check is disabled.

items.title: Tauri capabilities (permissions per window)
items.rationale: desktop.json grants updater:default and process:default (used by updater relaunch); default.json grants notification, autostart, store, os, opener, log, window ops for windows main+settings; clipboard.json clipboard read/write. updater:default must go with F0:4/F7; settings window entry follows app-shell/state-settings decisions; autostart relates to 8.5 risk. Least privilege after removals (AI, editor).
items.risks: Removing a permission still used by frontend code fails at runtime, not at build; verify by exercising each feature.

items.title: NSIS installer hooks: 'Open in Terax' Explorer verbs
items.rationale: Writes HKCU\Software\Classes\{Directory,Directory\Background,Drive}\shell\OpenInTerax (installer-hooks.nsh:6-19) and deletes them on uninstall (:23-25). These registry keys are SHARED with an installed Terax: installing lut would hijack Terax's verb and uninstalling lut would delete Terax's. Phase 0 isolation (F0:10, identity:1, 13.2:21, 16:26); verb label is visual (identity:2).
items.risks: Exe name must match the Cargo binary/productName after renaming.

items.title: macOS Info.plist and entitlements
items.rationale: Camera/microphone usage strings mention Terax (Info.plist:6,8, visual identity:2); entitlements grant camera and audio-input for programs run in the terminal and Terax voice input (STT, removed with AI per ADR-004). Keep only if CLI programs in the terminal need them (open question).
items.risks: Dropping audio-input breaks CLI tools that use the mic inside the terminal on macOS.

items.title: App icons and logos
items.rationale: Terax artwork (binary assets; android/ios sets are unused for a desktop app). Visual rebranding (identity:2, ADR-008) owned by the user's design; mobile icon sets can be dropped.
items.risks: None functionally; tauri build fails if referenced icon files disappear.

items.title: Cargo workspace manifest, lockfile and build script
items.rationale: Package name terax / default-run terax (Cargo.toml:2,8) determines the executable name (terax.exe, ADR-008 wants `lut`); lib terax_lib; workspace members crates/terax-cli and crates/terax-control-protocol; tauri-plugin-updater dependency (:154); bench feature. build.rs resolves the binaries/terax-cli-<target> sidecar (build.rs:15). Exe rename is required for installer/launcher isolation; crate/lib renames are rename-on-touch only. Dependencies are pruned per area removal (9.9:6).
items.risks: Renaming the bin changes paths that control.rs and hook commands embed; must be done together with agents area isolation.

items.title: package.json, pnpm workspace and lockfile
items.rationale: Package name terax (internal), pnpm 11.9.0 pinned, node >=22, scripts (several macOS-only python profilers), deps for areas being removed (ai-sdk, codemirror, updater plugin). Prune deps only after the import graph confirms impact (9.9:6); toolchain docs (F0:6, F0:7).
items.risks: minimumReleaseAge 4320 (pnpm-workspace.yaml:4) blocks freshly published versions during dependency bumps.

items.title: Vite, TypeScript, Biome, knip and size-limit configuration
items.rationale: Builds two windows (index.html, settings.html), manualChunks for AI/codemirror, __TERAX_BENCH__ define (vite.config.ts:214-218), bench identifier guard (:12-30), size budgets naming chunks of removed areas. Needs updates as areas are removed (F2:8) and when the shell is replaced; TERAX_BENCH env names are internal (rename-on-touch).
items.risks: Size budgets fail CI when chunk names disappear; update together with removals.

items.title: Real-application benchmark (app lab): frontend driver, bench feature, scripts
items.rationale: Useful for F0:11 measurements but macOS-only (bench.rs:722 window control). Its safety guard hardcodes the product identifier app.crynta.terax (bench.rs:17, run.py:58,216): after the Phase 0 identifier change it would no longer stop a bench build running under lut's product identifier. Must follow the identifier change (F0:10). Windows support is an open question.
couplings: terminal (__TERAX_BENCH__ branches in ghostty gpu modules)
items.risks: Stale PRODUCT_IDENTIFIER silently disables the guard; bench builds could share the real lut profile.

items.title: Startup/dist import-graph analyzers
items.rationale: Generic analyzers used by dist/eager budget tests; directly useful for F0:12 (import graph) and F2:8. No identity content.

items.title: Nix flake packaging Terax release binaries
items.rationale: nix/package.nix:13-26 downloads Terax release .deb/.app from github.com/crynta/terax-ai; it packages Terax, not lut, and is a Terax distribution channel (F0:5, 16:26). lut packaging is F7:6; a lut flake could be re-added then.
items.risks: None; nothing in the build references it.

items.title: Apache-2.0 license and Terax provenance notice
items.rationale: LICENSE is Terax's Apache-2.0 text; public/licenses/terax.txt is the provenance + modification notice (14.3:2, 14.3:3) copied into dist by Vite. Required by F0:2/14.3; bundling of third-party licenses is verified by a draft issue.
items.risks: Must not be removed during rebranding.

items.title: Repo hygiene: gitignores and VS Code settings
CodeRabbit review configuration
items.rationale: Terax's external review-bot config; Terax GitHub automation was already removed (commit 154a6cf). Not part of lut's workflow unless the user opts in.

notes: Repo-wide 'terax' inventory: 1964 occurrences / 553 distinct tokens (excluding .docs/): terminal 633, backend-core 513, agents 224, build-identity 171, ide-tools 170, app-shell 119, ai 71, state-settings 63. Class (a) items outside this area: dirs cache 'terax' (control.rs:758, terax-cli lib.rs:300, fs/read_policy.rs:15), ~/.cache/terax/shell-integration (pty/shell_init.rs:449), TERAX_* env vars injected into PTYs (TERAX_PANE_ID, TERAX_CLI, TERAX_CONTROL_ADDR/TOKEN, TERAX_TERMINAL, TERAX_BLOCKS, TERAX_USER_ZDOTDIR, TERAX_WSL_LOGIN_SHELL), hook marker name 'terax' (agent.rs:318) and __terax_notify (lib.rs:169), terax-pi-notifications, keyring service 'terax-ai' (src/modules/ai/config.ts:1), git refs refs/terax/* and .git/terax-* files (ide-tools), terax/ project dir (.terax/project.toml), store files terax-*.json (state-settings/ai), event names terax://... are internal. The identifier change alone isolates app data dir, stores, window-state and WebView localStorage; the dirs::cache_dir()/terax paths and env vars do not depend on it.
